execution: the release record still links the bound source
the blocklist entry is recorded so it can be removed
the executor allocates and names the isolated copy
the copy does not overwrite an existing file (no-overwrite)
the copy is validated against the stated client
not_prerequisites: a destination name from the model
a clean full decode of the source

execution: the destination slot is still free at execution time (collision check)
no file is overwritten or deleted
the new name does not collide with another file
the old value is recorded for the undo

declaration_disagreement.value: a declared identity / edition value that disagrees with the catalog

destination_evidenced.value: content names the item the file really is, and the catalog lists that item

free_slot.value: a catalog record of the destination item shows NO linked file (explicit null / empty / hasFile false); absent is not evidence

identity_agreement.value: a content value that contains a catalog identity value (title, alias, episode title or marker)

identity_disagreement.value: a typed title / episode / author / language field, or an episode marker in text, that disagrees with every catalog value after aliases and orderings

located_defect.value: a finding with known_defect true and a location

managed_app.value: context.arr.app is a managing app (sonarr, radarr, lidarr, readarr, bookshelf, lazylibrarian)

naming_surface_defect.value: M6: an explicitly empty, or differing, naming-surface field (absent is NOT evidence: it is unknown)

new_value.value: the catalog value the naming surface should carry, populated and different from the old value

no_settling_choice.value: no case-supplied choice (series_order, library_episode_order, wanted / monitored edition) that selects one candidate

source_bound.value: the managing app's record of the linked file (relativePath / file id) equals the case's file name or file id; for an unmanaged item the case item itself

support_grade_defect.value: located_defect from a result that ran to completion (state ran, status ok), or an error result whose cause is not tool

two_candidates.value: two or more legitimate candidates listed by the case (editions, episode orders, aliases with different numbering)

unsupported_selected_stream.value: client_comparison row unsupported, selection recorded or only_stream_of_type

insufficient_evidence.value: no other class established and healthy not established

metadata_naming.value: uncontradicted or content_verified (contested or contradicted is not naming)

healthy.text: at least one integrity result ran with status ok and is positively clean inside its stated scope (a parsed container with streams, a package with every stage clean, a decoded window with frames and no messages)
no known_defect finding and no collector veto in any shown result, of any execution state
no material uncertainty M1 to M9
identity is uncontradicted (no M5); positive content confirmation of identity is NOT required for none, which changes nothing

identity_levels.content_verified: a content or report_content observation agrees with the catalog on an identity attribute and nothing contradicts it
identity_levels.contested: only declarations, report_declaration or report_hash disagree with the catalog; no content observation settles it
identity_levels.contradicted_by_content: a content or report_content observation disagrees with the catalog on an identity or edition attribute
identity_levels.uncontradicted: nothing disagrees with the catalog, and no content observation confirms it

link_rules.meaning: may inspect this scope; never will resolve it
link_rules.offsets: every advertised offset whose window intersects the unresolved interval, in advertised order; "any" yields one template at the interval start; never an offset chosen by a recorded result

material_uncertainty.text: no positively clean integrity result exists at the item's container or package level (every one failed, timed out, was unavailable, was unknown or was not made)

an unclassified diagnostic (a finding kind ending _unclassified, probe_messages, input_failure, exit_nonzero_unclassified) inside a checked scope; a decoder_warning alone is not material and is not clean
a material conflict (MATERIAL_CONFLICTS) in any shown result

a signal that points INTO the unchecked remainder: a container duration that disagrees with the catalog runtime beyond tolerance, a decoded span shorter than the container duration, or a complaint (context.question) that names a part that was not checked

an identity or edition attribute of any declaration, content or report that disagrees with the catalog (after the case-supplied aliases, alternate titles, editions and orderings are applied) and is not settled by a content observation
a naming-surface declaration of this media type that is explicitly empty, or that differs from the catalog value
two legitimate candidates (orderings, numberings or editions listed by the case) that the observations fit, with no case-supplied choice that settles them
a stated client with an unknown verdict, an unread clause, or an ambiguous or unrecorded stream selection for a field it states
a complaint (context.question) whose subject no shown observation reaches

uncalled_rules: not a repeat of a call already made
not a repeat of a call that failed, timed out or was unavailable
